title: Chitropot (চিত্রপট)
overview: Served as the Creative Lead, spearheading the visual strategy and identity for the entire Fine Arts Admission Support Workshop 2025. Designed and laid out the official Workshop Book, ensuring an educational yet aesthetic experience for prospective students, and managed all posters, banners, and digital assets to maintain a unified visual language.
challenge: Establishing a highly creative yet structured visual language that effectively guides, motivates, and communicates with prospective fine arts students while maintaining academic rigor.
solution: Developed a colorful, vibrant brand identity heavily inspired by traditional Bengali motifs and watercolor textures, integrated with sleek modern typography and custom educational illustrations.

title: Gallery Hamiduzzaman
overview: Directed the complete Creative Management and Brand Strategy for major exhibitions (including 'Embodiment of Nature' and children's art shows) and regional art workshops. Designed clean and professional brochures, catalogs, social media content, and banners to solidify the gallery's prestigious brand.
challenge: Synthesizing visual content from multiple independent artists into a single, cohesive brand presentation for both high-end physical galleries and digital audiences.
solution: Created a minimalist, sophisticated identity system featuring neutral color schemes, elegant layout grids, and clean brand mockups that allow the artworks to stand out.

title: Charukola Animation Festival
client: Faculty of Fine Art, University of Dhaka
overview: Spearheaded the full creative direction, brand identity, and motion graphics suite for the 1st Animation Festival at the Faculty of Fine Art, DU. Designed festival promotional videos, intro motions, title slides, social media assets, and managed creative screening events like 'Memories' (মেমোরিজ).
challenge: Designing a visual style that captures the limitless creativity of animation while celebrating the traditional artistic heritage of the Faculty of Fine Art.
solution: Developed a modern, dynamic identity featuring a signature logo concept and hand-crafted animated graphics, coupled with a robust digital promotional toolkit.

title: Woven Heritage
overview: An exploration into the geometric soul of Shital Pati, a traditional hand-woven mat from Bangladesh recognized by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage. Successfully translated the physical constraints of traditional cane-weaving into a contemporary digital design system, producing tote bags, stationery, and apparel.
challenge: Translating the complex physical, organic textures of local weaving into clean, scalable digital vectors without losing its authentic artisanal essence.
solution: Employed systematic grid layout techniques and pixel art rendering to construct precise digital motifs of traditional elements (matsya/fish and stars) in a warm, earthy color scheme.

title: Jhumur & Biva
overview: Designed fluid storyboards, expressive character models, detailed backgrounds, and full 2D animations for the broadcast series 'Jhumur and Biva', aired on Deepto TV to raise awareness about child rights and community support.
challenge: Designing relatable and highly expressive characters that captivate young audiences while communicating sensitive educational and social topics.
solution: Crafted highly descriptive, colored character layouts and engaging hand-drawn environments optimized for smooth animation and modern TV broadcast formats.

title: DIKKHA E-Learning
overview: Designed and animated a large collection of visual assets, dynamic infographics, and character-driven explanatory videos for over 30 interactive e-learning courses powered by the ICT Division of Bangladesh.
challenge: Maintaining uniform brand aesthetics and high-level engagement while animating heavy volumes of technical and academic educational data.
solution: Developed a comprehensive graphic framework and reusable motion asset libraries, utilizing sleek vector designs and snappy text transitions.

title: Zainul Mela 2024
client: Faculty of Fine Art, Dhaka University
overview: Created the official branding, hand-drawn typography, and poster layout for Zainul Mela 2024. The design centers on the traditional 'Shital Pati' texture, showcasing rich Bangladeshi heritage through modern graphic design principles.
challenge: Finding a harmonious blend between traditional, organic folk motifs and contemporary digital typesetting layout standards.
solution: Leveraged fine art color theories inspired by traditional local melas, combined with high-contrast, custom-drawn Bengali typography overlaid on woven mat textures.
